Hi all — thanks for looping me in. Short answers:

- Yes, we can run an air-gapped demo in a lab. For an on-prem installation we'll provide an installer bundle and a set of images; no outbound calls are required for the runtime if you opt for an air-gapped distro.
- For HSM/KMS: we support customer-managed KMS integrations and can demo integration patterns with AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, and on-prem HSM via PKCS#11 during the session.
- Pre-demo network checklist: open ports for intra-service RPC (we'll send a checklist) and a VPN/SSH path if you want remote screen-share; we can also run via recorded demo if preferred for security reasons.

I've created a short public checklist for network and firewall items: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cDemoChecklist — please share with your IT Ops team.

Monica — recommend we ask for a list of regulatory questions ahead of time so we can have exact audit log examples. Elena — if you can provide your compliance contact, we'll tailor the demo.

Cheers,
